site.aboutParagraph1: The Luggies are musical adventures created for neurodivergent children and their families. We believe everyone is unique and special in their own way, and that's exactly what makes us amazing!
site.aboutParagraph2: Through music, play, and joy, we create inclusive content where everyone feels welcome. Each episode is carefully designed to be accessible and engaging for children with diverse needs.
site.missionText: To spread joy, music, and understanding. To show that it's okay to be different. To create a world where all children feel seen, heard, and loved.

site.faq1Question: How often are new episodes released?
site.faq1Answer: New episodes are released every Saturday. The English channel releases at 15:00 Stockholm time, and the Swedish channel releases at 09:00 Swedish time.
site.faq2Question: Is the content appropriate for all ages?
site.faq2Answer: Yes! The Luggies is designed for children of all ages, with a focus on being accessible and engaging for neurodivergent children. All content is family-friendly and positive.
site.faq3Question: Can I watch on mobile devices?
site.faq3Answer: Absolutely! The Luggies is fully optimized for mobile viewing. You can watch on YouTube from any device - phone, tablet, or computer.
site.faq4Question: Is the content free to watch?
site.faq4Answer: Yes, all episodes are completely free to watch on YouTube. Just subscribe to our channel to get notified when new episodes are released!
